1.
Heard learned counsel for petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. Present writ petition is filed by the petitioner for the following main relief:
"(i) To issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the
opposite party no.2 to pass the appropriate order on the application dated
22.09.2024 for transferring the case Crime No.246/2024 U/s 498A, 313, 323, 504
I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act Police Station Aliganj District Lucknow in any other police
Station in the district Lucknow contain as Annexure No.2 to this writ petition in the
stipulated period in the interest of justice."

entities.text: Priya Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for petitioner submits that grievance of petitioner would be sufficiently met in case her complaint is considered and addressed by opposite party no.2-Commissioner of Police,
Lucknow.

4. In view thereof, petitioner is permitted to raise her grievance before opposite party no.2-Commissioner of Police, Lucknow by moving a representation along with all the evidence in her support within a period of ten days from today along with a certified copy of this order.

5. In case such a representation is moved by petitioner, opposite party no.2 shall consider and decide the same by a reasoned and speaking order as per law within a period of two weeks from the date, a certified copy of this order along with representation is placed before him.

6. With the aforesaid, present writ petition is disposed of.
.
